name: Personal health record
blurb: One person's lab results, readings, targets, hypotheses, medication and vaccine doses, with "off target", "overdue" and "incomplete" worked out on every read.
about: A personal health record you can ask real questions of: whether a change you made moved the marker it was meant to move, which of your own hypotheses a result contradicts, and what is overdue. Your lab results, device readings, targets, what you take and the vaccine doses you were given are linked to the documents they came from and to standard codes, so every answer comes from your own data. Agents read your reports and keep the record current, on branches you review before anything reaches it.
sample: Noa Brandt, an invented person with two years of results
